title: Trappers
description: The people who go to the field. They belong to no research project: what each is in a project is its role.
x-rules: username is unique whatever its case, and has no spaces.
An inactive trapper is no longer suggested; an archived one is out of use. One taken from Trapper (trapper_pk) can only be seen here.

items.description:
One of the people who go to the field — {username, name, affiliation, email}. The people are global: they belong to no research project (what each is in a project is
its role, which is the project's). Its `username` is what it is called in the app, as the label of an SD card is, and no two have the same.

username.description: What the trapper is called in the app — required, and unique among the trappers (whatever its case), as the label of an SD card is.

name.description: The trapper's full name, written as it should be on a visit.

affiliation.description: Where the trapper works, free text.

status.description: Whether the trapper still goes to the field: an inactive one is no longer suggested, and an archived one is out of use for good (it never goes back).

trapper_pk.description: Its id in Trapper, when it was taken from there — such a trapper can only be seen here.

id.description: Its internal id — a UUID the app generates when it is kept, that never changes and is never typed: what the records that refer to it point to.

created_at.description: When it was kept here (ISO 8601, UTC, with a Z): written by the app, never typed.

updated_at.description: When it was last changed (ISO 8601, UTC, with a Z): written by the app, never typed.

deleted_at.description: When it was removed (ISO 8601, UTC, with a Z), if it was: it is no longer listed, but it is kept — nothing is deleted.
